items.title: 61531_Juan Tizol oral history interview
items.q: I left Rose to take charge of the delicatessen and to try to sell it

ctx.x: Jimmy Durante. Yes, he was the comedian in that particular show, and so, I decided, and I left Rose to take charge of the delicatessen and to try to sell it, and she stayed in Washington while I was with Duke
Ellington, until I got myself together, and she came over and met me there in New York.
